title: Binance Will List Rari Governance Token (RGT)
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance will list Rari Governance Token (RGT) and will open trading for RGT/BTC, RGT/BNB, RGT/BUSD, and RGT/USDT trading pairs at 2021-11-05 06:00 (UTC). Users can now start depositing  RGT  in preparation for trading Withdrawals for RGT will open at 2021-11-06 06:00 (UTC) Note: The withdrawal open time is an estimated time for users’ reference. Users can view the actual status on the withdrawal page. What is Rari Governance Token (RGT)? Rari Capital is a DeFi protocol that allows users to borrow, lend and earn yields on crypto assets. The platform offers a range of products such as tranched stablecoin pools, customizable lending and borrowing pools, and more. Rari Governance Token (RGT) is the governance token of the platform, which can be used to vote on governance proposals. RGT Listing Fee: 0 BNB.
